philosophy: Start with the friction, not the tech.

hackathons.project: Invited straight to the semi-finals the day after CityScapes won

lessons.title: Start with the friction, not the tech
lessons.body: Every hackathon started with the temptation to ask which API to use. By the end the opening question was who is frustrated, and why.

lessons.title: Vertical slicing before shared code
lessons.body: Each teammate owned an isolated directory, so no two people touched the same file. Coordination lives in communicated decisions, not chance.

lessons.title: The output is the product
lessons.body: A heat map nobody understands helps nobody. Polish is what turns data into something people actually feel.
